scenarios.query: Convert evals/fixtures/docs/architecture.md into an MP3 I can listen to on my commute.
scenarios.setup: A checkout of this repo at the branch under test, with its skills/ installed.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The tts skill loads. The assistant rewrites the markdown into speech-friendly prose before rendering, then produces an MP3 with a neural TTS engine and reports the output path.
expectations: The tts skill is invoked without the user having to name it
A rewrite pass happens before rendering rather than feeding raw markdown to the engine
An .mp3 file path is reported as the output

baseline_no_skill.notes: Measurement is tracked separately; see evals/README.md.

scenarios.query: Can you TTS the onboarding guide at evals/fixtures/docs/onboarding.md?
scenarios.setup: A checkout of this repo at the branch under test, with its skills/ installed, in a session where tts has not previously bootstrapped.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The explicit "TTS" mention routes to the tts skill, which checks its bootstrap state before rendering and produces an MP3.
expectations: The transcript shows an engine check before the first render command: a read of the bootstrap state file, a lookup or version call on the engine binary, or an explicit statement that the engine is already verified
An .mp3 file path is reported as the output

baseline_no_skill.notes: Measurement is tracked separately; see evals/README.md.

scenarios.setup: A checkout of this repo at the branch under test, with its skills/ installed.
scenarios.expected_behavior: A bare "tell me" idiom asks for a visual reply. The assistant answers in text. If it raises audio at all, it does so only as the short offer the description specifies ("btw, do you want mp3 output?") and does not render anything unless the user confirms.
expectations: The answer is delivered as chat text
Any mention of audio is an offer, not an action

baseline_no_skill.notes: Measurement is tracked separately. A no-skill instance is expected to pass this scenario trivially, which is why the baseline matters: a passing score here credits the skill only once the no-skill run is recorded.
